button.purpose: Action labels in Inter at 14px and weight 600.

mono.purpose: IDs, diffs, code, and direct machine feedback in JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Quiet separation for elevated panels and overlays.

shadows.name: glow-info
shadows.purpose: Mint focus, hover, and active-state glow.

motion.name: materialize
motion.purpose: One-shot entrance for route content and panels.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default control color, border, and focus transition.

motion.name: hover-lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:32px; padding:8px 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:#51F0A8; color:#0B0B0D; font:600 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:rgb(81 240 168 / .8); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgb(81 240 168 / .45),0 0 12px rgb(81 240 168 / .35); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(81 240 168 / .35),0 0 12px rgb(81 240 168 / .3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that does not compete with mint.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:32px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #3F3F45; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#D4D4D8; font:600 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:rgb(30 30 33 / .4); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:0; border-color:#51F0A8; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(81 240 168 / .35); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent field with a hairline border and mint focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #3F3F45; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#E8E8EA; font:400 16px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#86868A; } .ds-input:focus { outline:0; border-color:#51F0A8; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(81 240 168 / .35),0 0 12px rgb(81 240 168 / .3); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Opaque graphite container with a quiet hairline border.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:20px; border:1px solid rgb(43 43 48 / .8); border-radius:12px; background:#141416; color:#E8E8EA; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; color:#A8A8AC; font-size:14px; line-height:20px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: An explicit label whose hue communicates revision state.
components.css: .ds-status-review { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:rgb(255 177 136 / .1); color:#FFB188; font:500 11px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Compact navigation with mint reserved for active and focus states.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:8px; color:#86868A; font:400 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgb(30 30 33 / .5); color:#E8E8EA; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:0; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(81 240 168 / .35); } .ds-nav-item-active { background:rgb(81 240 168 / .1); color:#51F0A8; }

narrative.overview: Kenoma is a calm technical command deck for documentation teams. Its near-black canonical theme, compact information rhythm, and precise status language make document workflows feel inspectable and dependable. Brand character appears through restrained signal color and stateful glow, while ordinary content stays quiet and readable.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace is reserved for data-shaped content and direct machine feedback.
Color communicates state rather than decoration.
Dark is canonical, with near-black surfaces and restrained signal glows.
Dense layouts follow a repeatable console grid and spacing rhythm.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Each signal hue is reserved for its state. Mint identifies primary actions and focus, while peach, lime, and magenta remain semantic.

rules.name: The Mono-is-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for IDs, diffs, code, and direct machine feedback.

rules.name: The Caps-is-Caption Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for captions, table headers, and section labels.

rules.name: The Glow-is-State Rule
rules.body: Glow communicates interaction, focus, and state, never static decoration.

rules.name: The Soft-Corner Rule
rules.body: Use the established 12, 8, and 4 pixel radius scale. Circles are reserved for status dots and avatars.

dos: Do use monospace for IDs, diffs, code, and machine feedback.
Do reserve each signal hue for its state and mint for primary actions.
Do align content to the console grid and vertical rhythm.
Do use glow to communicate focus, hover, and state.
donts: Don't use monospace for general body copy.
Don't use uppercase for body text or buttons.
Don't introduce pill shapes or heavy drop shadows.
